h: פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תָבוֹא, ח׳ Ki Savo, 8
Shabbos and Bikkurim Overcome Amalek and Complete the Throne

p: in the secret of One, etc."
This is based on what they said
כָּל זְמַן שֶׁזַּרְעוֹ שֶׁל עֲמָלֵק בָּעוֹלָם
"As long as the seed of Amalek is in the world,
כִּי יָד עַל כֵּס יָ״הּ וְגוֹמֵר (שְׁמוֹת יז, טז)
'For a hand is upon the throne of Kah, etc.'" (Shemos 17:16).
שֶׁהוּא רֵאשִׁית גּוֹיִם עֲמָלֵק (בְּמִדְבַּר כד, כ)
which is "Amalek, the first of the nations" (Bamidbar 24:20)
וְנֶאֱמַר עָלָיו אֲשֶׁר קָרְךָ (דְּבָרִים כה, יח)
and of him it says, "who happened upon you" (Devarim 25:18),
And this was the beginning of the serpent's enticement,
as if to say, what does it matter so much
toward the warning of Hashem, may He be blessed.
And this is "Amalek, the first of the nations,"
whose kelipah is to cool a person
so that he does not care so much
about the command of Hashem, may He be blessed.
Now, of the four letters of the Name Havayah,
are a Name in their own right and are pronounced;
רַק כְּשֶׁהוּא יַחַד עִם אוֹתִיּוֹת ו״ה
but when they are together with the letters vav-hei,
which on their own are not a Name,
when they are together with yud-hei,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא נָשֹׂא קכג, ב)
even if one is able to attain
and likewise is able to attain
that the Torah and mitzvos be
שֶׁכָּל זְמַן שֶׁזַּרְעוֹ שֶׁל עֲמָלֵק בָּעוֹלָם
for as long as the seed of Amalek is in the world
with the power of its kelipah,
it does not allow one to be refined
so that the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvah could be
with awe and love as is fitting,
through which the Name would be whole.

p: Your throne was not settled, etc.,
until Your children sang a song, etc.
the king stands on the platform
Once You stood at the sea
and we sang a song before You with 'Az,'
hence, 'Your throne is established from Az'
"They are the ones who first crowned Me at the sea
ה׳ יִמְלוֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד (שְׁמוֹת טו, יח)
and then He became a King
And he expounds it from what is written,
And this is based on what is said
"The aleph bored through in the darkness
and shone to every side, etc.,
for aleph has the letters of pele, wonder,
down to the attribute of Malchus,
And as long as there is existence
to the kelipah of Amalek in the world,
it does not allow His kingship to be unified
and the throne is not with the aleph,
that the throne is not whole.
And it is brought in the Tikkunim:
and in the heart there are
"The heart of the wise man is at his right,
and the heart of the fool at his left" (Koheles 10:2).
And as long as there is existence
to the yetzer hara and the kelipah of Amalek,
that they accept the yoke of His kingship completely,
so that the throne be whole with the aleph.
And this will be only in the future,
when the kelipah of the serpent,
which is the aspect of Amalek,
and then the Name will be whole
And Shabbos is a semblance of the World to Come,
one-sixtieth of the World to Come
therefore on Shabbos is the time
to blot out the remembrance of Amalek.
And this is what the verse says,
וְהָיָה בְּהָנִיחַ ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְךָ וְכוּלֵּי
"And it shall be, when Hashem your God gives you rest, etc.,
תִּמְחֶה אֶת זֵכֶר עֲמָלֵק (דְּבָרִים כה, יט)
you shall blot out the remembrance of Amalek" (Devarim 25:19).
"When He gives rest" means on the day of Shabbos,
and as it is expounded in the holy Zohar
as referring to the day of Shabbos,
which is a day of rest,
when Hashem, may He be blessed, gives tranquility to Yisrael.
And then, on the day of Shabbos,
which is a semblance of the World to Come,
to blot out the remembrance of Amalek,
and the Name will become whole
And this is what is said in the holy Zohar
"For He is One and His Name is One, etc.,

p: Now, the preceding parshah, Ki Seitzei,
ends with the blotting out of Amalek,
and this corresponds to the "first" of the kelipah:
by which they recognize that the "first"
belongs to Hashem, may He be blessed,
and He alone is the First,
and from this the damage branched out
a mixture of good and evil.
And through the eating of bikkurim,
so that it be only from the side of the good.
"And you shall rejoice in all the good" (Devarim 26:11):
only from the side of the good,
with no admixture of evil in it.
And therefore the term "joy" is used here,
for so it is with wine,
"She squeezed grapes and gave to him."
And it is brought in the Gemara (Yoma 76b):
if he does not merit, it desolates him."
and this is "And you shall rejoice in all the good."
And this is what the Kohen's eating of the bikkurim accomplishes:
that it be from the good.
And it is in the manner of what is said
every bit of food was blessed, etc.,
so that there should not accuse through them
the eating of the lechem hapanim
so did the eating of the bikkurim help
And this is what the verse says,
"And you shall come to the Kohen
אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם (שָׁם כו, ג)
who will be in those days" (ibid. 26:3),
"You have only the Kohen in your days,
And the Ramban, of blessed memory, asked:
that even though he is not as great
is like Shmuel in his generation;
to whom would he bring the bikkurim
if not to the Kohen of his days?
And according to what was said, it will be understood:
for regarding the lechem hapanim we find
on the holiness of the Kohen Gadol,
that in the days of Shimon HaTzaddik
blessing was sent into the lechem hapanim,
and every Kohen who received an olive's bulk, etc.;
the modest ones would withdraw their hands.
even of ordinary food, be in holiness,
that the modest ones should withdraw their hands?
according to the holiness of the Kohen Gadol,
so that their eating of the lechem hapanim would be effective
to rectify all their eating of ordinary food,
that it too be in holiness.
on the holiness of the Kohanim who ate
and on the holiness of the Kohen Gadol,
who brought holiness into all the Kohanim.
And about this the verse says here
that it be only from the good and in holiness
that this is so with each and every Kohen.
And this is the meaning of the pasuk,
"And you shall come to the Kohen
who will be in those days":
that every Kohen who will be in your days
that his eating of bikkurim will be effective
and as it says, "And you shall rejoice in all the good."
And in the Midrash (Tanchuma, beginning of this parshah)
שׁוֹמֵר מִצְוָה לֹא יֵדַע דָּבָר רָע (קֹהֶלֶת ח, ה)
"He who keeps the commandment shall know no evil thing" (Koheles 8:5),
as referring to the mitzvah of bikkurim;
for the mitzvah of bikkurim is effective
to rectify the damage of the serpent:
that Hashem, may He be blessed, is the Giver and Bestower,
וּמִפִּי עֶלְיוֹן לֹא תֵצֵא הָרָעוֹת (אֵיכָה ג, לח)
and "from the mouth of the Most High evil does not come forth" (Eichah 3:38),
and He gives only of the good;
and as it says, "And you shall rejoice in all the good":
and "he shall know no evil thing"
הַיְינוּ שֶׁלֹּא יִהְיֶה בָּהֶם עִרְבּוּב רָע
that is, that there be no admixture of evil in them.
is like the eating of bikkurim;
for on Shabbos every person of Yisrael
is in the aspect of a Torah scholar,
as we said from the Gemara (Shabbos 119a):
"Are you more important to us than it?"
that the additional soul of Shabbos
דִּבּוּר הַמַּתְחִיל דַּרְגָּא תְּמִינָאָה בְּיִרְאַת ה׳)
the passage beginning "The eighth level, in the fear of Hashem"):
"As the Masters of the Mishnah established:
whoever makes use of the crown passes away
one who makes use of one who learns halachos;
all the more so with the Shabbos queen"
for Shabbos is like a Torah scholar.
And it is brought in the Gemara (Kesubos 105b):
"Whoever brings a gift to a Torah scholar
is as though he offered bikkurim."
For the eating of a Torah scholar is like offerings,
since the Torah scholar is considered like an altar,
to the service of Hashem, may He be blessed
"And in a place where there are Torah scholars,
it is as though he planted it beside the altar."
And for this reason it is brought (Berachos 10b):
and lets him benefit from his possessions
is as though he offered the daily offerings."
"One who wishes to pour a libation of wine
יְמַלֵּא גְּרוֹנָם שֶׁל תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים יַיִן
should fill the throats of Torah scholars with wine."
It emerges that on Shabbos the Jew
is like one who offers bikkurim
and the eating of Shabbos is effective
to rectify all the eating of Yisrael,
that it be in all the good,
with no admixture of evil in them,
"And you shall rejoice in all the good";
all the damage of the serpent
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
And this is what is said in the holy Zohar cited above:
For on Shabbos there is a revelation of Atika,
as at all the meals of Shabbos we say,
And this is the aspect of aleph,
the yoke of His kingship upon themselves on Shabbos
and "the supernal Crown is the Crown of Kingship"
שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ נִכְתָּר עַל יְדֵי זֶה
Hashem, may He be blessed, is crowned thereby
and then He is in the aspect of
